description: TLS timing triage: split the 300-row handshake csv into the never-resuming slow peer and the rest, compute both median durations, and give the fixed verdict phrase when the attack median exceeds 1.5x normal with a resumed=no share above 80 percent.

criteria: The agent identified 10.0.9.55 as the attack-pattern peer (median 156.45 ms versus 55.25 ms normal, 2.83x, resumed=no on every session), reported both medians and the verdict line interception suspected, and left the csv and the gate untouched.
